project.name: WQA Implementation — June 2026
project.primary_goal: Kickoff (WQA + report + plan, M1), technical fixes (M1), analytics setup (M1), content production (M3+), link building (M4+), monthly reporting throughout.

sprints.name: Sprint 1 (Kickoff)
sprints.notes: Kickoff phase: WQA → WQA Report → Project Plan. Auto-tracked deliverables flip to completed as each artifact lands.

sprints.name: Sprint 2 (Technical)
sprints.notes: Technical fixes — 404s, redirects, indexability. Month 1. Grouped by action type.

sprints.name: Sprint 3 (Local SEO)
sprints.notes: Local SEO foundation — GBP audit, citation cleanup, review velocity. Month 2 placeholders; expand on deep-dive.

sprints.name: Sprint 4 (Content)
sprints.notes: Content production Months 3+. Strategy/gap analysis first, then grouped metadata work + batched heavy rewrites by priority.

sprints.name: Sprint 5 (Links)
sprints.notes: Link building. Month 3 = strategy + plan. Months 4+ = monthly batches (URLs in description).

sprints.name: Sprint 6 (Reporting)
sprints.notes: Recurring monthly performance report sent to client at the end of each month. Serves as visual month-break in the Tasks view.
